title: Машина Времени: 4 Прошедших Времени
description: Выбери правильную форму (Past Simple, Past Cont, Past Perfect).

items.question: I (played / was playing / had played) a game when the computer crashed.
I was playing a game when the computer (crashed / was crashing / had crashed).
When I (arrived / was arriving / had arrived), they were playing.
When I arrived, they (played / were playing / had played) football.
I (finished / was finishing / had finished) the project before I went out.
I had finished the project before I (went / was going / had gone) out.
While we (walked / were walking / had walked) home, it started to rain.
While we were walking home, it (started / was starting / had started) to rain.
She (called / was calling / had called) me after she had heard the news.
She called me after she (heard / was hearing / had heard) the news.
